pp.join.title: Join <red>30,000+ partners</red> worldwide
pp.join.sub: Apply in your Client Portal. We review every application within 24 hours.
pp.faq.title: Questions about <red>our programs</red>
pp.faq.sub: What partners ask before they join.
pp.faq.1.q: Which program is right for me?
pp.faq.1.a: If you have an audience of traders — a channel, a community, a course or a website — start as an Introducing Broker. If you work with other partners, build a network on top. If you want a brand of your own, ask your partner manager about White Label.
pp.faq.2.a: Up to 87% of the spread on every lot your referred clients trade. Your rate per lot grows with your network: $5.00 on Starter (0–50 clients), $7.50 on Gold (51–200) and $10.00 on Elite (200+). There’s no cap on clients or volume.
pp.faq.3.a: Every day. Commissions settle at 00:00 server time, and we cover processing and withdrawal fees.
pp.faq.4.q: What marketing support do I get?
pp.faq.4.a: Ready-made banners, landing pages and videos, free TradingView charts, real-time trading signals to share with your audience, the White-Label Academy and a dedicated partner manager.
pp.faq.5.a: Open and verify a TradeQuo account, then apply to the IB program in your Client Portal. There’s no joining fee, and we review every application within 24 hours.
pp.end.title: Start earning <red>today</red>
pp.end.sub: Up to 87% of spread, daily payouts and a manager who picks up the phone.
